title: Large Numbers & Operations
description: Class 5 IMO — Large numbers: 7- and 8-digit numbers and crores, place value in the Indian system, Roman numerals, operations on large numbers and estimation.

topics.title: 7- and 8-digit Numbers & Place Value
topics.concept:
After Lakhs come Ten Lakhs and Crores. One crore is written 1,00,00,000 (a 1 with seven zeros). The smallest 8-digit number is 1,00,00,000 and the largest is 9,99,99,999.

In 5,23,45,678 the 5 is in the Crores place and stands for 5,00,00,000. Each place is ten times the one to its right.

examples.problem: What is the place value of 5 in 5,23,45,678?
examples.solution: 5 is in the Crores place, so its value is 5,00,00,000.

recap: Places: Ones … Lakhs, Ten Lakhs, Crores.

quiz.q: What is the place value of 4 in 3,45,67,890?
quiz.explanation: 4 is in the Ten Lakhs place, so its value is 40,00,000.

topics.title: Roman Numerals
topics.concept:
Roman numerals use letters: I = 1, V = 5, X = 10, L = 50, C = 100, D = 500, M = 1000. A letter can be repeated up to three times to add (XXX = 30).

When a smaller letter comes before a larger one, we subtract: IV = 4, IX = 9, XL = 40, XC = 90, CD = 400, CM = 900.
recap: Smaller before larger means subtract (IV=4, IX=9, XL=40).

quiz.explanation: 9 is one less than 10, written IX.

topics.title: Operations & Estimation
topics.concept:
Large numbers are added, subtracted, multiplied and divided just like smaller ones, place by place.

Estimation gives a quick, close answer. To estimate, round each number to the nearest lakh or crore first. So 4,56,789 rounded to the nearest lakh is 5,00,000.

examples.solution: The ten-thousands digit 5 is 5 or more, so it rounds up to 5,00,000.

recap: Operate on large numbers place by place.
Estimate by rounding to the nearest lakh or crore.

quiz.explanation: The ten-thousands digit 8 is 5 or more, so it rounds up to 8,00,000.

questions.explanation: The ten-thousands digit 4 is less than 5, so it rounds down to 6,00,000.

questions.q: What is the place value of 8 in 8,12,34,567?
questions.explanation: 8 is in the Crores place, so its value is 8,00,00,000.
